slice: Profile-scoped minimum and maximum annual USD salary filters
behavior: Jobs search accepts inclusive annual USD minimum and maximum bounds and composes them with keyword, title, company, location, remote, and source filters before the SQL result limit.

Comparisons require matching salary currency USD, period YEAR, and a numeric endpoint relevant to each active bound. Missing, malformed, nonannual, other-currency, or otherwise incomparable rows do not match while a salary bound is active.

Inverted bounds are rejected. Named saved searches preserve and restore the bounds within their owning profile; clearing the selected search clears both bounds. Legacy saved searches without salary fields remain readable.
Filtering and saved-search operations do not schedule discovery or submit applications.
